newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Sept notionnel looks to 129.86 and beyond.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Sept notionnel looks to 129.86 and beyond.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF will seek further upmoves on Monday, initially to 129.86, technical analysts said.
Using Elliott Wave theory, Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase in London, said the contract had formed the bottom of a fourth wave at 126.40.
"The fifth wave has broken up through significant resistance at 129.06 and a move above there will potentially target 129.86," he said.
That level was the June 9 high and May 16 low on continuation charts.
At 0821 GMT, September notionnel futures were at 129.34, up 42 basis points on the day.
Redeker said once the contract was above 129.86, the next target was defined by trendline resistance on continuation charts at 130.08.
"Above there we will look at 131.58 and if we get through there we will have a look at the all time high at 132.94," Redeker said.
On continuation charts 131.58 was the low on February 11, while the all time high at 132.94 was formed on February 18.
To the downside, Redeker said initial support was offered at the low so far this session at 128.74, with some further support below there at 128.38.

"A very important support level comes in at 128.28," said Redeker. "It is an intra day cycle high and is a significant Elliott wave level. While above 128.28 the contract will remain postive but if we break below there is will signal a sharper decline."
Redeker noted further props below 128.28 at 127.88 and 127.18 ahead of 126.60.
Technical analysts at a European bank in London said the contract had broken through downtrend resistance during Friday's session and needed to keep going.
"It needs to avoid a reversal back under 128.40 which would dampen current momentum," they said in a research note.
At the short end, September Pibor was unchanged on the day at 96.56.

The European bank analysts said Pibor had broken above the main donwtrend line running through the mid 96.50s and initially there was scope to get back into the mid 96.60s. But a close below 96.50 would negate the break higher they warned.
